title: Certify the trapping clock uniformly over every positive rational activity pair
statement: Fixoriginal0<->A+B,B<->2B andEVERY rationala,b>0. ChooseFIXEDK>=max(2,acceptedK0),V=2+a+a^-1+b+b^-1,Gamma=1/[4(K+1)(1+a)(1+b)]. Totalrates areGamma ab F_K(N),Gamma AB F_K(N-2),Gamma b(K+1)B F_(K+1)(N-1),Gamma(K+1)B(B-1)F_(K+1)(N-2). Coefficient lists usew! denominators, stay<=1/4 with reciprocal-polynomialV bounds, and preserveexactpi=Pois(a)tensorPois(b),classN^2 andALL originaledges. Reference degree0/1 drift usesu=1/[10(1+b)],e=bu,d=b/[40(1+b)^2],h0=1+4u+e,h1=4u,hB=uB forB>=2,L=A+h(B),boundedjumps11/10,andmargin-2d outsideR0=ceil1000(1+a)(1+b)^2 by the supplied all-state boundary cases. Fixed-degree polynomial ratio coefficients computeC_K with deviations<=C_K/N; R=ceil(R0+100C_K/d+2C_K+10) givesnewembeddedmargin-d. Withtheta=d/10,H=exp(thetaL),ell=d^2/20, ground-state drift holds outsideC={N<=R}; A_C=J_K(1+R)^(K+3) pays insideactivity without enumeration. Sinceall acceptedK0 baselinechannels are present, E_new>=t E_baseline witht=min(Gamma ab/c0,Gamma(K+1)b^2/c0),soordinarymajorantg=g0(V)/t haspolynomialV bounds. The reversiblecomposition yieldsG=ell^-1+A_C(1+ell^-1)g, also polynomialV. Exactpi(activity)=2Gamma ab sum_(j<=K)(a+b)^j/j!+2Gamma(K+1)b^2 sum_(j<=K+1)(a+b)^j/j! andactivity>=c_K V^-p(1+N)^2 satisfy136C atALL(a,b,x0,epsilon). All rate/bound evaluation is fixed-exponent rational, with paid computable preprocessing and polynomial COMPLETE-BINARY work. The robust physicalsubcase was already known/countonce; this adds its all-activity polynomial nominal certificate. No all-R/nonreversible/face-grading or practical-rate conclusion.
